Cadences and model superiority remain untested; immutable dependency manifests are engineering support only.
DTM-A17: Freeze whole date groups across correlated instruments; retain outcome dependency intervals and label maturity when purging distinct horizons. Recursive downstream training requires upstream predictions fitted without the same outcome group.

CRL-17: OOF upstream inputs, target-specific mixture/calibrator ownership and matured eligible label support belong in closure evidence. Arbitrary daily/weekly update schedules and taken-trade-only calibration are not justified.
CRL-20: Part A contains user questions and references missing earlier replies; missing artifacts or replies cannot be fabricated. A structured synthesis is not equivalent to a raw message log.
DRF-A07: Example rank/confidence numbers are hypothetical; stored predictions must declare whether the value is a score, probability, interval or state plus its evidence and clock. No calibration validity inferred from display text.
DRF-A26: Record actual consumed columns and transformations, their available dates and independent sample groups. A later richer census cannot be projected backward onto an earlier run; unused/report-only fields cannot be credited as model inputs.

EXT-031: Retain snapshot, velocity and receipt/reconnect lineage separately. Full reconnect snapshots are state acquisitions, not new flow; keepalive or a newly delivered snapshot cannot manufacture fresh underlying field content.

The retained page does not establish an exact shared snapshot/velocity pair identity or historical velocity archive. F11 may store explicit typed evidence; F06/F07/F12 own age/quality/adapter semantics.
TECH-10: Retain every trial/attempt and unsuccessful result so later analyses can account for search. The paper connects selection bias and nonnormal returns to inflated Sharpe estimates and describes dependence/selection assumptions.
F11 must preserve inputs, search identity and results; DSR estimation and correlated-trial sensitivity are V03/V04 work, not a new F11 predictor or a substitute for chronological/future evaluation.

static_scope_issues.title: No committed semantic artifact manifest or complete dependency DAG
static_scope_issues.static_reasoning: ArtifactStore correctly protects individual payload bytes but kind is caller metadata and not bound into blob identity; cache_key hashes only supplied names/versions. No typed measurement/OOF/final-fit/label manifest validates transitive existence, column ownership, expected target/horizon or an atomic run closure. A label blob can be referred to under a new ArtifactRef kind without changing its bytes.
static_scope_issues.proposed_bounded_disposition: Add a separate bounded semantic manifest/commit layer above the existing raw blob store; preserve generic byte-store behavior for existing evidence consumers.

static_scope_issues.title: Input audit configuration and value contracts remain forgeable through ordinary mutation
static_scope_issues.static_reasoning: InputValue has no post-init validation; fitted_dependency_ids can be a mutable list. InputAudit exposes mutable declared, required, cut and fold_version, and manifest does not recheck admitted reads against its current cut. For example create cut20, read known15, assign cut10, then manifest reports cut10 with the previously read future input. Clearing required can suppress omitted-input detection.
static_scope_issues.proposed_bounded_disposition: Freeze typed input metadata and audit configuration; pin immutable source/field versions and validate admission as well as manifest/restore boundaries.

static_scope_issues.title: Direct Fold construction can bypass chronological/grouped fold derivation
static_scope_issues.static_reasoning: Fold has no post-init validation and _training trusts its supplied membership after only population-hash, ID-disjointness and per-row maturity/span checks. A forged Fold can keep the correct full sample hash, put a pre-evaluation row and an evaluation row with the same date_group on opposite sides, and pass _training even though chronological_fold rejects that split. It can also change purged/training-window membership without derivation evidence.
static_scope_issues.proposed_bounded_disposition: Validate/reconstruct fold membership from a retained immutable sample population and registered boundaries, including grouped dates and target/maturity intervals, at every fitted-artifact admission.

static_scope_issues.title: Fitted closure checks are necessary but insufficient for typed OOF admission
static_scope_issues.static_reasoning: FittedArtifact stores caller-declared membership but not the retained training sample manifest, target/horizon, artifact content, prediction mode or exact permitted fit route. validate_oof checks presence, acyclicity, fold string, fit time and sample/date exclusion; it does not validate target compatibility or training dependency intervals against the requested prediction. Declaring a final-fit artifact role does not itself prevent OOF use.
static_scope_issues.proposed_bounded_disposition: Bind fit evidence to validated fold/sample manifests and semantic artifact role; register upstream fold routes separately from the supplied artifacts and enforce row-level target/horizon/OOF purpose.

static_scope_issues.title: Actual transform/model bytes are not enforced against the immutable fit identity at read boundaries
static_scope_issues.static_reasoning: Frozen model dataclasses lack structural/content validation. Ordinary dataclasses.replace can change coefficients, scaler means, cells, or columns while preserving id and fit_artifacts. predict verifies fitted membership, not that actual parameters/read schema match the content that created that identity. Publication/read attestation for model and calibration state is not present.
static_scope_issues.proposed_bounded_disposition: Admit model/calibrator payloads through the typed content-addressed manifest, preserve executable code/config/numerical settings, and reconcile actual consumed columns and transform states before serving.

static_scope_issues.title: Checkpoint validation returns caller-owned mutable state without state identity or typed closure
static_scope_issues.static_reasoning: compatible_checkpoint verifies an asserted cache_key and serializability, then returns the original state object. Subsequent mutation changes the accepted object; a key can be copied onto a different state without proving that the state was produced by that closure.
static_scope_issues.proposed_bounded_disposition: Preserve immutable typed checkpoint payload/state hash and commit lineage; verify source closure and state content upon restore.

static_scope_issues.title: No minimal changed-descendant rebuild service or bounded artifact growth policy
static_scope_issues.static_reasoning: cache_key distinguishes supplied versions but cannot explain transitive invalidation or reuse independent measurements. code_manifest conservatively hashes all package/test/reference/config files; partition invalidation intentionally requires a complete code match. These existing conservative behaviors do not implement UP-F11 column-level incremental rebuild.
static_scope_issues.proposed_bounded_disposition: Add finite dependency graph traversal and first-change impact reports with node/edge/payload/row bounds; count full build and incremental work/storage. Do not silently evict evidence or weaken conservative callers without parity evidence.

static_scope_issues.title: Runtime F11 binding is a declaration rather than validated stored closure
static_scope_issues.static_reasoning: F11.FROZEN declares models/transforms/calibrators/training_closure. validate_bindings checks nonempty identity strings and required enabled producers, but does not resolve or hash-check the referenced model and fit artifacts. Its module correctly disclaims implementation certification.
static_scope_issues.proposed_bounded_disposition: Provide a narrow artifact resolver/adapter that returns verified closure evidence for F11.FROZEN and existing model readers; do not implement all declared learned ports.
